notes.title: Escape Legacy VR - Update v1.10
notes.content:
Major Improvements on VR Motion Sickness :

-Added +30% VR Hand Reach (Less Pushback Effect)
-Left/Right Rotation Camera Snaping will Recenter VR Pawn 
-Directional Movement will also Recenter Pawn
(We suggest using Grab to enable Laser usage on items
which are located far from your VR Pawn)
-Stair Movement Smoothed with applied Ramp Movement
-Doors/Drawers won't collide with VR Pawn anymore
-Acceleration/De-acceleration Removed

Enjoy Escaping!
